content: Braintrust official docs emphasize systematic evaluations, playgrounds for prompt/model/scorer iteration, immutable experiments, production trace scoring, and CI/CD regression checks. Self-hosting docs describe a hybrid model where the customer controls the data plane while Braintrust provides managed UI/auth/platform updates; deployment docs cover AWS/GCP/Azure data-plane infrastructure. Braintrust docs/changelog list SDK coverage across TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, Ruby, and C#.
